intro: Over 90% of Suriname is covered by rainforest, one of the highest shares in the world.

chapters.title: Forest
text: The Central Suriname Nature Reserve protects a vast rainforest. Brokopondo Reservoir is one of the largest lakes made by a dam. Most people live on the coast.

keyTerms.meaning: A lake made by a dam.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Suriname's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
